text: Hello and welcome to live coverage of the Premier League clash between Burnley and Tottenham at Turf Moor.
Championship winners Burnley host their third successive Premier League match, looking to collect their first points of the season.
Vincent Kompany’s men were comfortably beaten in their opening fixture, losing 3-0 to reigning champions Manchester City, before taking a 16-day break from the division.
They were supposed to face Luton Town in their second game, but it was postponed as Kenilworth Road was not ready.
Upon their return, the Clarets were brushed aside by European hopefuls Aston Villa, with a brace from Matty Cash and a goal from Moussa Diaby helping Unai Emery’s side to a 3-1 victory.
Despite being in the relegation zone, Burnley will take encouragement from their narrow win over Nottingham Forest in the EFL Cup during the week, with Salford City awaiting them in the third round.
As for Tottenham, they will be frustrated with their early exit from the EFL Cup after losing to Fulham on penalties in the second round.
However, new manager Ange Postecoglou will be happy with their start to the Premier League season, with his side collecting seven points from their first three matches.
The Lilywhites opened their campaign with a 2-2 draw against Brentford before securing back-to-back wins over Manchester United and Bournemouth.
Keeping clean sheets in their last two fixtures, Spurs will be looking for a third straight shutout for the first time since May 2022.
Tottenham are currently in third place and could end the day at the top of the table if they win and other results go their way.
Burnley make nine changes to the side that beat Forest in the EFL Cup during the week.
Centre-back O'Shea and winger Gudmundsson are the only two to keep their place, with Muric, Brownhill, Redmond, Larsen, Rodriguez, Manuel and Delcroix among the players to move onto the bench.
Ekdal, Vitinho and Ramsey are all absent due to injury.
Trafford, Beyer, Roberts, Berge, Doster, Cullen, Amdouni and Koleosho are all recalled.
As for Tottenham, they make nine alterations to the team that lost on penalties to Fulham.
Bissouma, Maddison and Son all return to the side, with Van de Ven and Solomon the only two to retain their places.
Richarlison started the first three games of the season and scored against Fulham, but is on the bench.
Kompany has made a lot of changes to the Burnley squad since becoming their manager before the start of last season.

They fielded the two youngest average starting XIs in their two Premier League games so far this season (23 years and 206 days v Manchester City, 23 years and 340 days v Aston Villa), giving them an overall average of 23 years and 273 days.
In their last Premier League campaign of 2021-22, the Clarets had the second-oldest starting lineups on average (28 years and 343 days).
Burnley get this Premier League clash under way.
Amdouni with the first kick.
Burnley have had more of the ball in the opening few minutes before giving it away to Kulusevski on the right.
The winger drives forward before switching a pass across to Solomon just outside the box, but it goes just behind the Fulham man, who cannot take it in his stride.
GOALLLL! FOSTER SCORES! 1-0 BURNLEY! What a start for the home side against Tottenham.
Berge sends a pass down the left to Koleosho, who gets behind Porro and runs into the box.
Koleosho then drags a low pass into the middle of the box, with Foster getting ahead of his man before poking his shot into the net.
Koleosho wanted the ball more than Porro and used his pace to rush past the right-back inside the box.
He then kept his composure and found Foster, who slotted a low shot across the goal and into the net.
Burnley have avoided defeat in their last 10 matches when scoring the opening goal in the Premier League dating back to September 13, 2021 against Everton (lost 3-1).
Solomon has possession on the left side of Burnley's box and tries to shift the ball onto his right foot and curl a shot into the bottom corner.

events.action: curl a shot into the bottom corner

text: But he is crowded out by a couple of defenders and his attempt is blocked.
Maddison uses his quick feet to get past a couple of defenders and drives with possession into the box.
He pokes the ball past Beyer and looks to run past the centre-back, but is blocked.
Gudmundsson has the ball on the right and slides a throughball into the path of Foster.
The striker rushes into the box and tries to go past van de Ven, but the defender does well to shield the ball, allowing it to roll out for a goal-kick.
Son looks to create a chance for Tottenham and slides a pass towards Porro, who runs inside from right-back and into the box.
However, his touch is poor and Roberts gets ahead of him to stop the danger.
Trafford has not had a save to make in the game but has made a couple of mistakes with the ball at his feet, this time launching a pass out for a throw-in.
Solomon has brought energy to this Tottenham side and does well to steal possession inside Burnley's half.
He drives down the left and looks to get a shot away from a tight angle, but it is blocked.

GOALLL! SON SCORES! 1-1! Captain Son scores his first goal of the season! Porro has possession on the right inside Tottenham's half and launches the ball over the top of Burnley's defence towards Son.
The winger drives forward, playing a quick one-two with Solomon before chipping Trafford.
Solomon does well with the assist.
He has the chance to move inside with possession and shoot himself but is patient and waits for Son to get away from his marker.
He pulls a pass across the box to Son who finishes well.
Gudmundsson has a corner on the right and looks to curl his cross towards the near post.
Foster gets ahead of his man, but blasts his shot wide.
Tottenham have only failed to score in one of their last 23 Premier League games, finding the net in each of their last 16.
Spurs are looking to win three consecutive league games for the first time since May/August 2022 (four).
Tottenham have the momentum and look the most likely to score again.
Solomon has possession on the left and has the chance to play a simple pass to Maddison, who overlaps him but sends it out for a goal-kick.
Berge has possession outside the box and moves forward with the ball before playing a pass across to Amdouni.
He takes one touch before blasting a shot wide from outside the box.
Maddison has been a key part of Tottenham’s side since signing from Leicester, but is struggling to make an impact on this game.
He has had just eight touches.
Koleosho has the ball on the left flank and drives inside with possession.
The winger reaches the middle of the box and slots a pass into the feet of Foster, who has his shot saved by Vicario.
The flag then goes up for offside.
Burnley could be forgiven for retreating after conceding, but have looked the better side since Tottenham’s equalising goal.
They have had a couple of chances to score, but have struggled to make the right final pass.
Sarr is shown the first yellow card of the game after throwing the ball away.
A poor booking for a midfielder who will be at the heart of all the action.
Tottenham are starting to put the pressure on.
Maddison searches for space inside the box, but his path for a shot is blocked by the Burnley defence.
He combines with Soloman before Son sets it back to Sarr.
The midfielder has his low shot blocked, with Maddison unable to convert the rebound.
Solomon gets behind Roberts on the left and powers towards the ball before whipping a dangerous cross into the box.
It flashes past Trafford and away from danger.
If someone rushed into the middle, they could have had a simple finish.
Dakhil pokes Solomon's throughball out for a corner.
Maddison then curls a cross into the box, but it is headed away.
CHANCE! Maddison is starting to get into the game.
He comes in from the left wing and plays a quick one-two with Sarr on the edge of the box.
The England international then whips a shot across the goal and towards the bottom corner, with Trafford getting down to push it away.
Porro has the ball on the edge of the box and drags his shot across the goal.
Son has his hands in the air after requesting a pass from the right-back, with Postecoglou also unhappy with his decision to shoot.
Foster had a quick start to the game and scored the opening goal, but has not had much of the action in the last few minutes.
He drops deep to receive the ball, helping Burnley retain possession in their own half.
Burnley are doing their best to stick to the same style that helped them get promoted from the Championship.
They are taking risks in their own half with short passes around their box.
Kulusevski is the second player to be shown a yellow card after pushing Koleosho.
Gudmundsson takes the following free-kick and curls a cross towards the back of the box.
O’Shea is unmarked but decides against shooting, instead heading the ball back across the box.
Sarr is there and clears it away.
Gudmundsson is the first Burnley player to be shown a yellow card in this game.
He is booked for a late tackle on Maddison.
Udogie does well to flick the ball past O’Shea to win a free-kick in a crossing position.
Maddison takes it quickly and chips it across to Romero on the left.
The defender wants to head it back across the goal, but Trafford is there to collect it.
GOALLLL! WHAT A STRIKE FROM ROMERO! 2-1 SPURS! The away side have turned the score in their favour.
Maddison is tricky on the left and gets past a defender before sending a cross into the box.
It bounces around before a clearance goes to the feet of Romero, who blasts his shot into the top corner.

events.action: blasts his shot into the top corner

text: VAR checks for a possible offside, but the goal stands.
Son drives forward with possession and spins past Berge.
The Tottenham captain then sends a throughball to Maddison, who turns on the edge of the box before falling to the floor.
He wants a free-kick, but there was very little contact from O'Shea.
HALF-TIME: BURNLEY 1-2 TOTTENHAM
Tottenham conceded inside four minutes, but have the lead after a thunderous strike from Romero.
Foster gave Burnley the lead with his second goal of the season, getting on the end of a pass from Koleosho and poking his shot into the net.
However, their lead lasted just 12 minutes.
Son was unleashed on the break by Porro, with the Spurs captain playing a quick one-two with Solomon before chipping his attempt over Trafford.
Maddison had a shot saved by the goalkeeper before Romeo struck late in the half.
The centre-back made the most of a poor clearance on the edge of the box and powered his strike into the top corner.

events.action: powered his strike into the top corner

text: There was a short VAR check for offside, but the goal stood.
Burnley showed a lot of quality in possession, but failed to create many meaningful chances after their early goal.
Amdouni looked to get the hosts back in the lead with a strike from outside the box, but it whistled wide.
As for Tottenham, they have been the better side after a slow start.
Maddison took his time to get involved, but has been a crucial part of their attack and has done brilliantly to link the midfield with the attack.
Solomon has also caused a lot of problems with his pace and has constantly forced Roberts back.
Kompany has seen enough and has decided to make a couple of changes before the restart.
Brownhill was a vital part of the side that won the Championship, and replaces Berge.
Delcroix also makes his way onto the pitch to strengthen Burnley's defence.
Gudmundsson is off.
The game is back under way.
Tottenham have started the half brightly.
Porro has possession on the right flank and threads a pass through to Kulusevski.
He moves past a couple of defenders before finding Son, who has his shot blocked.
Maddison receives a pass next to the byline on the left and fakes to shoot, forcing a defender to commit to a block and sliding ahead of him.
The skilful move allows him to shoot from a tight angle, but his effort is saved by Trafford.
OVER! Koleosho rushes past a number of Tottenham players before Romeo tackles him.
However, the ball only rolls as far as Brownhill, who dribbles towards the edge of the box before curling a shot over the bar.
Koleosho has shown a lot of quality with possession, this time getting down the left side of the pitch and beating Porro.
The winger then slides a pass into the feet of Amdouni, but he cannot keep it under control and the chance is gone.
GOALLL! MADDISON SCORES! 3-1 SPURS! Maddison scores for the second consecutive game.
Udogie wins possession and rolls a pass into the feet of the midfielder, who is in lots of space outside the box.
He has time to touch the ball out of his feet before curling his shot into the corner.

events.action: curling his shot into the corner

text: Trafford was given no chance.
Udogie battles well on the left and does not give up.
He wins possession in a dangerous area and thinks quickly to make a pass inside to Maddison.
The former Leicester man is free and takes his time before curling a shot past the reach of Trafford.
CHANCE! Foster goes close to scoring his second.
The striker breaks down the right side of the box and gets ahead of Romero, but his shot is pushed over by Vicario.
Brownhill goes into the book after a late tackle on Kulusevski.
Kompany is about to make another change.
Redmond is being given his instructions by the manager.
Amdouni has shown he has a lot of energy in the Burnley attack, but has not been as effective as Foster.
He is replaced by veteran Redmond.
Burnley fail to clear the ball away and it comes out to Bissouma on the edge of the box, but his low drive across the goal is collected by Trafford.
Maddison and Solomon combine on the left flank before the latter sends a pass inside to Bissouma.
The midfielder drifts inside and shoots, but his effort goes wide.
GOALLL! SON SCORES AGAIN! 4-1 SPURS! Tottenham score their fourth of the game through Son.
Solomon drives down the left and into the box before slotting a pass across to Son.
He is free in the middle and crashes his effort past Trafford.
Solomon assists Son for the second time and is being congratulated by the rest of the Spurs side.
He keeps the ball under control and waits for options in the middle, with Son making a surging run into space before scoring from close range.
Son has now scored five goals in 12 Premier League appearances against Burnley.
GOALLL! HAT-TRICK FOR SON! 5-1 SPURS! What a day for the new Tottenham captain.
Maddison plays a pass out to Porrot, who curls a pass behind the Burnley defence towards Son.
The 31-year-old controls the ball well under pressure, before rolling his shot past Trafford.
Porro's pass had the perfect amount of weight on it.
Maddison was shouting for a return pass after giving it to the right-back, but Porro had other ideas.
He slotted an accurate pass into the feet of Son, who did the rest with a composed finish.
Tottenham make a change with the game secured.
Sarr is replaced in the midfield by Hojbjerg.
Koleosho has been excellent for Burnley on the left wing and does not deserve to be on the losing side.
Larsen is given a chance to make an impression off the bench.
Solomon also comes off after two assists.
Perisic takes his place.
As Celtic manager, Spurs' Postecoglou won his last nine league matches against promoted sides by an aggregate score of 31-7.
Spurs themselves lost their last such match (3-2 v Bournemouth in April), but haven't lost consecutive games against promoted teams since April 2012 (against Norwich City and Queens Park Rangers).
Son makes his way off the pitch after scoring a hat-trick and is given a fantastic reception by the away crowd.
Richarlison comes on looking to score his first Premier League goal of the season.
Beyer is shown a yellow card after pulling Perisic's shirt.
Beyer's yellow card was his last moment on the pitch.
He is replaced by Cork.
Perisic lets Redmond get close to him on the left before pushing it past the substitute.
He chips a cross towards the back of the box with Porro making a darting run, but the Spaniard drags his shot wide.
Burnley pack men into the box from a corner, with Tottenham unable to get it away from danger.
Cullen looks to shoot from inside the box, but his goal-bound attempt is blocked by Romero.
POST! Burnley almost get one goal back.
Larsen hasn’t been able to make much of a difference since coming on, but comes inside with possession before passing it inside to Brownhill.
The midfielder looks to shoot from outside the box, with his attempt defecting off a defender and against the post.
Hojbjerg is shown a yellow card for a late tackle on former Southampton team-mate Redmond.
Delcroix heads the ball straight at Vicario after getting on the edge of Redmond’s inswinging cross from the right.
It hit the top of his head.
Burnley are enjoying a spell of dominance in the game.
Substitutes Redmond and Larsen are getting a lot of the ball, with the hosts keeping possession well.
Tottenham make another change.
Kulusevski makes his way off and is replaced by Skipp.
The winger showed his quality during the game, but did not register a goal or assist.
Maddison also makes his way off the pitch and claps the away fans.
Royal is given the final few minutes to make an impression.
Bissouma has possession in the middle of the pitch and skips past a tackle before looking for Hojbjerg with a throughball.
The Denmark international runs behind Roberts and goes down under contact from the defender, but nothing is given.
There will be six minutes of additional time.
Cork holds off a defender inside the box and looks to chip a pass over to Redmond on the other side, but Udogie jumps high to head it away.
Delcroix is shown a yellow card for tugging back Richarlison.
That's Burnley's fourth yellow card of the game.
Burnley are losing by four goals, but Foster is still showing his intent in the attack.
He is showing a willingness to press and is tenacious in his tackles inside Tottenham's half.
GOALLL! BROWNHILL SCORES! Burnley get a goal back, with Tottenham leading 5-2.
Brownhill plays a fast one-two with Cullen and rushes past Van de Ven before blasting his shot past Vicario.
He has been brilliant since coming on as a substitute.
Cullen was thinking quickly when receiving the pass from Brownhill and was able to slot a return pass right into the path of the midfielder.
Brownhill took it round van de Ven and was taken out by the defender, but got his shot away in time to score.
FULL-TIME: BURNLEY 2-5 TOTTENHAM
Son scored a hat-trick as Tottenham thrashed Burnley at Turf Moor.
The Clarets started the game well and opened the scoring through Foster, who got ahead of his marker to poke Koleosho’s pass across the box and into the net.
However, Tottenham came into the game after a slow start and turned the score in their favour.
Son rushed forward on the break and played a quick one-two with Solomon before chipping Trafford to equalise.
Spurs then went ahead in first-half stoppage time after a stunning goal from Romero.
Maddison added a third soon after the restart with a fantastic curling effort before Son scored twice more to complete his hat-trick.
He netted his second after directing his shot past Trafford from close range, with Porro assisting the third.
His pinpoint cross behind Burnley's defence found the 31-year-old, who took the ball into his stride and slotted his effort in.
Brownhill then netted a consolation for the hosts in stoppage time.
Burnley will be looking to secure their first win of the season when they travel to Forest after the international break, hoping to repeat their success in the EFL Cup.
As for Tottenham, they host Sheffield United in their next fixture and will be confident of another victory after collecting three in a row in the Premier League.
That's all for today, goodbye.
